description: FastAPI route handlers for user management, including CRUD operations, authentication, and email notifications.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance for user-related endpoints.

methods.name: read_users
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users with pagination, accessible only to superusers.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Create a new user and send a notification email if enabled.

methods.name: update_user_me
methods.description: Update current user's information, ensuring email uniqueness.

methods.name: update_password_me
methods.description: Update current user's password after verification.

methods.name: delete_user_me
methods.description: Delete current user's account, disallowed for superusers.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Register a new user without login, ensuring email uniqueness.

methods.name: read_user_by_id
methods.description: Retrieve user details by user ID, with privilege checks.

methods.name: update_user
methods.description: Update user details by user ID, restricted to superusers.

methods.name: delete_user
methods.description: Delete a user by ID, with checks to prevent self-deletion for superusers.
